walletPage.heading: Payout Methods
walletPage.intro: Store the payment methods buyers may use for your sale offers. You can allow crypto, bank transfer or both when creating an offer.
walletPage.cryptoCopy: Direct payment to your personal wallet.
walletPage.chooseFirst: Select a cryptocurrency and network first.
walletPage.confirmOwn: I confirm that this is my own public receiving address.
walletPage.confirmChecked: I have checked the coin, network and full address.
walletPage.bankCopy: Direct transfer from the buyer to your bank account.
walletPage.ibanNote: The full IBAN is shown to a buyer only after your offer has been reserved.
walletPage.confirmBank: I confirm that these bank details may be used to receive payments for my sales.
walletPage.importantCopy: BetInsight does not receive payment on behalf of the seller. For bank transfers, the seller later confirms the actual receipt of funds. Only then may the reserved Units be transferred to the buyer.
